why: A Nov 2024 arXiv paper introduces a bilevel-programming method and reports the conjecture holds for all products of 8-vertex Lemke graphs when configurations are restricted to at most 4 vertices (the leading candidate counterexample family, but a restricted sub-case); unclear if this constitutes settling a genuine case of the full conjecture or just a partial computational check, so I could not confidently classify it as case-settling progress versus adjacent computational work.
queries: Bilevel Programming Pebbling Numbers Lemke Graph Products Graham conjecture result

found.title: Bilevel Programming for Pebbling Numbers of Lemke Graph Products
found.note: Preprint using a new bilevel optimization method; reports Graham's conjecture holds for products of 8-vertex Lemke graphs restricted to configurations supported on at most 4 vertices. Not read.
